VOLCÁN CHOCOLATE 👇receta escrita👇 CLICK @laura.lopez.mon para más recetas fáciles 💥GUÁRDATE💥 esta receta de pastel de chocolate | lava cake, facilísimo de hacer con 5 ingredientes, sin robots ¡nunca falla! ➖➖➖➖➖➖ 📍 INGREDIENTES 4 unidades 200 g chocolate (mínimo 55% de cacao) 70 g mantequilla 4 huevos M 70 g azúcar 50 g harina trigo común (sin levaduras) Para pincelar los moldes : mantequilla y cacao puro en polvo ➖➖➖➖➖➖ 📍ELABORACIÓN 🔹️ Pon en un recipiente el chocolate y la mantequilla y fúndelo. Deja atemperar 5 minutos 🔹️ Mientras pon en un bol los huevos y el azúcar y bate con unas varillas hasta que espumen. Añade el chocolate y mezcla con una espátula hasta que se integre por completo 🔹️ Añade la harina tamizada y mezcla con la espátula hasta que esté perfectamente integrado 🔹️ Pincela los moldes con mantequilla a punto de pomada y espolvorea con cacao en polvo 🔹️ Llena los moldes con la masa hasta 1 cm del borde. Introduce en el congelador 30 minutos 🔹️ Saca del congelador e introduce en el horno precalentado a 220°C durante 12 minutos ⚠️ la temperatura interior de tu horno puede variar respecto a la mía (cada horno es un mundo) por lo que el tiempo de cocción puede variar entre 12 y 15 minutos. Deberás probar variando los minutos hasta conseguir el punto, pero nunca será menos de 12 ni más de 15 🔹️ Saca del horno y deja reposar 2 minutos. Separa la pared con el fijo de un cuchillo y desmolda 🔹️ Sirve inmediatamente ➖➖➖➖➖➖➖ Feliz día 🤗 #lauralopezmon #lavacake #micuitchocolat #volcandechocolate #coulant

Part 2 of my slow cooker dessert series: Chocolate Lava Cake! 🍫 Rich chocolate cake with a warm, creamy center, made right in the slow cooker. Ingredients • 1 box Devil’s Food cake mix • Oil and eggs called for on the box • Whole milk to replace the water, using the same amount • 1 tsp vanilla extract • 1 box (3.9 oz) instant chocolate pudding mix • 2 cups cold milk • 1 bag (11–12 oz) semisweet chocolate chips Directions Prepare the cake batter according to the box, replacing the water with whole milk. Stir in vanilla and pour into a greased slow cooker. Whisk the pudding mix with cold milk for 2 minutes, then dollop it over the center. Don’t stir. Sprinkle chocolate chips on top. Cover and cook on Low for 2 to 2½ hours, checking around 1½ hours. The edges should be set and the center soft and gooey. Want all 5 recipes? Chocolate Volcano Cake Ingredients: 200g dark chocolate (70%) 150g butter 150g sugar 3 eggs 100g flour 25g cocoa powder 8g vanilla sugar 2g salt 3-4g baking powder (optional, for a fluffier texture) Preparation: Melting Chocolate and Butter Break the chocolate into pieces, mix it with butter, and melt over a double boiler or in the microwave (in short 20-second intervals, stirring in between). Making the Batter In a separate bowl, whisk the eggs with sugar and vanilla sugar until light and fluffy. Pour in the melted chocolate and butter mixture, then stir well. Sift in the flour, cocoa powder, salt, and baking powder (if using). Mix gently. Baking Preheat the oven to 170°C. Pour the batter into a 20cm round cake tin lined with parchment paper. Bake for 20-25 minutes. The cake should remain slightly moist inside (check with a toothpick—it should come out slightly sticky). Cooling and Serving Let the cake cool completely in the tin. Optionally, dust with powdered sugar or serve with a scoop of ice cream and caramel. Enjoy! 🍫🎂 #cake #easyrecipe #cupcakes #foodlover #brownies #chocolate #dessert #foodtok #fyp #cookie

🍒 An Incredible Chocolate Cake! Delicate Vanilla Cream and Rich Cherry Filling! Meet the Chocolate “Volcano” Cake with a delicious surprise inside! The combination of rich chocolate, creamy vanilla custard, and juicy cherries makes this dessert absolutely irresistible and beautiful! An easy yet impressive cake that will make any tea time special and amaze your guests! 🍫🌋 Ingredients: For a 22 cm (9-inch) baking pan Chocolate Cake Batter: * 4 large eggs * 120 g sugar * A pinch of salt * 150 ml warm milk * 1 tsp vanilla extract * 80 ml vegetable oil * 40 g cocoa powder * 300 g all-purpose flour * 10 g baking powder Vanilla Custard Cream: * 600 ml milk * 1 egg * 100 g sugar * 60 g cornstarch * 50 g butter * 2 tsp vanilla extract Cherry Filling: * 250 g pitted frozen cherries * 50 g sugar * 10 g cornstarch For Decoration: * 20 g chocolate Baking Instructions: Bake at 180°C (350°F) for 40–45 minutes. 🍒 Chocolate Volcano Cake — a stunning and delicious dessert filled with silky vanilla custard and a juicy cherry lava center! Soft chocolate sponge, smooth vanilla cream, and a rich cherry filling create the perfect combination of flavors. The best part? It’s easy to make, requires no mixer, and looks like a beautiful celebration cake! Be sure to try this wonderful recipe and treat your loved ones! ❤️ #ChocolateCake #ChocolateVolcanoCake #CherryCake #VanillaCustard #CherryFilling
